questions.question: Define plankton.Explain phytoplanktons and zooplanktons with examples.
questions.solution_html:
• Define planktons. Explain phytoplanktons and zooplanktons with examples. /
  • [CO3]
  • • Plankton refers to the free-floating microorganisms. They must live in open water for at least
  • part of their life. Phytoplankton produce their own food using sunlight. Eg: Diatoms, Chlorella,
  • Anabaena. Zooplankton are animal-like planktons that depend on other organisms for food -
  • protozoans, which feed on phytoplankton, bacteria and detritus. Eg: Amoeba, Paramecium.

questions.question: Explain the different types of spoilage of milk.
questions.solution_html:
• Explain the different types of spoilage of milk. / [CO1]
  • • Milk is highly nutritious and easily spoiled by microorganisms. Spoilage results in undesirable
  • changes in taste, odour, texture, and appearance. [2] Explain different spoilage in detail: [8]
  • Acidic Spoilage (Souring) , Gas Production (Stormy Fermentation ), Proteolytic Spoilage
  • (Putrefaction) , Ropiness / Sliminess, Lipolytic Spoilage (Rancidity), Sweet Curdling - Caused by
  • spore-formers like Bacillus. Milk curdles without much acid production. , Flavour changes ,
  • Discolorations etc.
